svg.aria-label: The revision mode of the researcher skill. Boxes: The record of the experiments, when the project holds none (stop); You confirm the run's configuration and its budget (stop); /paper revision-coach: the parsed comments with their commitments (a run of another skill); The split of the comments: results comments and text comments (stop); The dataset, for a comment that needs one the project does not hold: candidates with their size, licence and fit to the limits (stop); Builder: one piece of code a results comment needs, from the session's brief (agent); Reviewer: the code against the brief, the test again, what makes a result false (agent); A piece of code that does not pass its review (stop); Experiments: one campaign per results comment, its jobs through the scheduler (script); Compare: each result against the baseline, a diagnosis and a proposal for each that does not beat it (the session reads and judges); A result that does not beat the baseline, under the manual setting (stop); A result short of what was set, in research: it beats the baseline, under the manual setting (stop); A comment the results do not answer yet: what was tried, the cause and the next proposal (stop); Consolidate, once: run_all.sh in a clean copy through the scheduler, each number compared, the record written again (script); A number that does not reproduce (stop); Baseline: its jobs again through the scheduler, for a baseline number that differs (script); Integrity agent, Stage 2.5: the sampled depth, the ethics check last (agent); Compliance agent, Stage 2.5 (agent); A failure-mode block, a compliance block, or a BLOCKED or CONDITIONAL ethics verdict (stop); A FAIL: the correction list to confirm (stop); /paper revision: the correction round (a run of another skill); The third correction round failed: you decide (stop); The checkpoint after Stage 2.5 (stop); The strategic coaching, at most 8 rounds, unless you say just fix it (stop); /paper revision: the revision, Stage 4, on revision-comments.md with the result files (a run of another skill); The checkpoint after Stage 4 (stop); An incomplete revision: each item left, with its reason (stop); The completeness check of each comment's answer, Stage 3', in place of the re-review (the session reads and judges); The checkpoint after the completeness check (stop); A fresh integrity agent, Stage 4.5: the full depth, the ethics check last (agent); Compliance agent, Stage 4.5 (agent); A failure-mode block, a compliance block, or a BLOCKED or CONDITIONAL ethics verdict (stop); A FAIL: the correction list to confirm (stop); /paper revision: the correction round (a run of another skill); The third correction round failed: you decide (stop); The checkpoint after Stage 4.5 (stop); A README in the old layout: /researcher readme offered (stop); The jobs submitted: the job ids in the README, and the run stops (stop); A job that fails: its log and its script (stop); The entry point: the line of Quick start a call without a mode matches (stop); An unfinished run: continue it or start a new one (stop); A run that fails: retry it or pause it (stop).

svg.text: revision answers one comments file on a paper of a project that research started or adopted. The split takes the commitment types the coach gave: add_experiment and add_analysis mark a results comment. Each results comment is one campaign of the project's Experiments stage, with Build first only for a new dataset or a new baseline, and of Frame

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: only the choice of a dataset runs, for a comment that needs one the project does not hold. A result short of what was set goes on, on your word, named as below what was set. Only a result that beats the baseline reaches revision-comments.md and /paper revision; a result that does not is a dead end, named in no response and no manuscript text. The

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: README names each campaign with the comment it answers, so that a new session resumes the revision from it. Each run of paper is invoked through the Skill tool with its own stops, which are not drawn. A second round of comments is a new run.
